metadata.protocolName: MIC of Olive Leaf Extract against L. monocytogenes F2365
metadata.author: paper2protocol
metadata.description: Two-fold broth microdilution MIC assay, replicating Liu et al., PLOS ONE 17(1):e0263359 (2022), doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0263359. Eight OLE concentrations (128-1 mg/mL) by two-fold serial dilution in BHI broth; 50 uL OLE + 50 uL of a 1:1000-diluted overnight culture per well (100 uL total); eight replicates per concentration, plus OLE-only, positive and negative controls.

metadata.displayName: Opentrons 15 Tube Rack with Falcon 15 mL Conical

params.message: HANDOFF: incubate 24 h at 37 C, then read OD600 on a microplate reader at 37 C with 0.05 linear agitation (paper: BioTek, Gen5 v3.00.19).
